likely_cause: A PostgreSQL connection drop reached the analysis worker's dedicated pg.Client during connection setup before its error handler was attached, allowing Node to terminate the Vite process with an unhandled error event.
evidence: sveltekit-frontend/logs/startup/vite-2026-11-19T17-44-38-776Z.log: repeated analysis notify listener and pool connection termination errors followed by node:events:497 unhandled error and Node.js v22.23.3 exit.
logs/turboquant/launch-2026-11-19T16-35-56.err: Gemma 4 model loaded and llama-server listening on 127.0.0.1:8090.
Read-only port probe: PostgreSQL :5432 reachable, llama-server :8090 reachable, Vite :5173 unavailable; RabbitMQ :5672 and embedding sidecar :8081 unavailable.
RabbitMQ and embedding sidecar failures are separate from the captured fatal Node PostgreSQL client event.
change: Attach pg.Client error and end handlers before connect() and LISTEN so a connection failure cannot become an unhandled EventEmitter error; preserve existing polling fallback.
